_why: The wiki writes actor-type in kebab-case and finer-grained than the store's org_type
vocabulary, which is snake_case and coarser. resolve_orgs passed the value straight
through, so only nonprofit / business / utility happened to match; every other value hit
the trigger, fell back to 'other', and logged a proposal. 81 of 142 orgs ended up typed
MAPPING, NOT APPROVING. Adding the 17 kebab-case spellings as terms would fragment the
vocabulary into two dialects for the same categories -- the same mistake as keying the
CAP as doc_type='cap' when 'plan' was already approved. The source's spelling is
JUDGEMENT CALLS are marked below. They live here rather than in code so they can be
changed without a patch, and so it is obvious that somebody chose them.
_unmapped_is_a_finding: An actor-type absent from this map is NOT silently passed through to the trigger. It is
reported by resolve_orgs and left NULL, because falling back to 'other' is exactly how
the drift went unnoticed for 81 orgs.

_judgement_calls.state-program: Michigan Green Communities. The wiki says 'state-program', so 'government' follows its own label -- but MGC is run by the Michigan Municipal League, a nonprofit association. Flip to advocacy_coalition if you read it that way.
_judgement_calls.trade-association: Michigan Energy Innovation Business Council -- a business advocacy body, so advocacy_coalition rather than business.
_judgement_calls.fellowship-program: ReDirect. A fellowship programme is not an organisation kind; 'other' is the honest answer rather than a guess at nonprofit.
_judgement_calls.government-commission: Planning/Housing/Transportation Commissions. Neither an office nor a department; 'government' is the true coarse answer.
_judgement_calls.religious-organization: Church of the Good Shepherd. Needs the new faith_group term -- see below.

_new_term.faith_group: The only genuinely new category. 'nonprofit' would be technically true and lose the thing that matters: the CAP names Places of Worship as their own engagement channel in Strategy 3, so faith organisations are a distinct route to residents, not a funding structure.
